Identified as this saint because: A 14th-century Georgian icon in the Art Museum of Georgia, filed by Commons under Category:Icons of Saint Paul from Deesis. It is the apostle Paul of the Deesis, the folder's apostle - not Paul I of Constantinople (6 November) nor Paul of Thebes. Commons describes it: Icon of a Deesis tier from Ubisi
